final: SELECT schools.School FROM (SELECT schools.School, satscores.AvgScrRead, schools.County, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY schools.County ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC NULLS LAST) as rank FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F') AS subq WHERE subq.rank <= 5
